correctness.rationale: Each point is on D=(q^{2n}-1)/(q-1) distinct unweighted horizontal lines. Two different points share a line exactly when their spatial coordinates differ and s-t=σ(z,w), so the counting-measure normal operator is K=(D-1)I+Σ_w f(w,t+σ(z,w)). Central-frequency decomposition yields cI+F_η with c=D-1. At η=0, F_0=all-ones on Q=q^{2n} spatial points. For η!=0, F_η is Hermitian, F_η²=Q I by symplectic-character orthogonality, and tr F_η=Q. Thus eigenvalues ±q^n have multiplicities (Q±q^n)/2 for each of the q-1 central frequencies; c+Q multiplicity1 and c multiplicity Q-1. c=q when n=1 gives nullity q(q-1)²/2; c>q^n when n>=2 gives injectivity. Orthogonal spectral projectors yield inverse and pseudoinverse with exact sharp condition number. Independent complete incidence Gram reconstruction for q=3,n=1 checked nullity and all eigenlevels; the all-prime-power claim follows algebraically, not numerically.
